text:
sara-marketing: Quick sync — we want to run a focused microexperiment on the pricing page copy + calculator UX next week. Goals: reduce FAQ opens, increase 'Start free' clicks from pricing, and better qualify inbound. Thinking 2x2: FAQ concise vs expanded, calculator inline vs modal. Thoughts?

james-growth: Love it. Can we add a tier-name axis too? e.g., 'Scale' vs 'Team' labels. Also we'll need GA events: pricing_view, calc_use, faq_open, start_trial_click.

eva-ux: I'll mock both calculator flows in Figma. Inline may increase time-on-page; modal might be cleaner for conversion. Figma link: https://figma.com/file/placeholder (will replace).

nina-analytics: For events, propose a single event `pricing_interaction` with props: `variant`, `calculator_variant`, `faq_variant`, `tier_label`. I'll also create a funnel in Looker. Need final event names by Monday.

mike-cs: For inbound routing, if the calc projects >$500/mo or selects enterprise options, route to Enterprise queue; else go to standard Sales triage. Tag leads with `qual:pricing_calc`. We'll need the estimate band (low/med/high) in the webhook.

olivia-prod: We can do this behind a feature flag. Engineering ETA ~5 business days to wire variants + experiment gating. Need final copy & acceptance criteria.

sara-marketing: OK — proposal: run 4 variants: (A) concise FAQ + inline calc + 'Scale' tier, (B) concise FAQ + modal calc + 'Scale', (C) expanded FAQ + inline calc + 'Team', (D) expanded FAQ + modal calc + 'Team'. Run to 10k unique pricing page impressions or 2 weeks, whichever first. @nina-analytics can you confirm metric set? @eva-ux deliver mocks by Wed? @james-growth will draft hypothesis and heatmap plan.

james-growth: Hypothesis: concise FAQ reduces faq_open by ~30% and increases start_trial by ~8%. I'll also add clickmap for calculator CTA and ensure UTM tagging.

eva-ux: Mocks due Wed. Microcopy rec: FAQ header "How pricing works" -> "How we charge" (shorter). Recommend calculator label: "Estimated monthly cost" and primary CTA text consistent across variants.

nina-analytics: Confirmed metric set: primary = start_trial_ctr; secondary = faq_open_rate, calc_engaged_rate, inbound_qualified_rate. I'll configure experiment flags and cohorts, and surface daily deltas in the morning report.

mike-cs: For routing we need `pricing_estimate_band` in the webhook payload (low/medium/high). I'll update the CS playbook and create reply templates for high-value inbound.

olivia-prod: Rolling plan: start with 10% traffic canary for 48h, escalate on any error spikes to #release-war-room. Engineering to add logs for `pricing_interaction` events to trace anomalies. Also ping Legal for any naming/regulatory concerns on tier labels.

sara-marketing: I'll compile the brief and post to #marketing-review by EOD. Draft copy below — please edit inline: 

--- copy draft ---
Concise FAQ bullets: 3 short bullets on billing cadence, prorate, and cancellation.
Calculator label: "Estimated monthly cost"
Primary CTA: "Start free — no card required"
Lead tag: `qual:pricing_calc`
--- end draft ---

james-growth: Small nit: "Start free" might imply a perpetual free tier. Suggest "Start free trial" for clarity, and add UTM params for experiment variants.

eva-ux: Agreed keep CTA consistent. Also I'll attach low-fidelity flows for inline vs modal.

sara-marketing: Thanks all — I'll iterate and drop the final brief + links in #marketing-review. :rocket:
